<div class="card-body">
'''Obi-Wan's Cape''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">オビ＝ワンのケープ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費して、反乱軍かエイリアンに配備する。耐：損耗＜５を得る。戦闘開始時に配備されていたら、１フォース消費して、能力値＝１の相手のキャラクターを一人選び、移動を強要する（移動コストなし）。移動しなかったら、そのキャラクターを直ちにロストデッキへ置く。耐：損耗＜５。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-57o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">気高きジェダイと神秘な力のシンボル。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Obi-Wan's Cape.

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on a Rebel or alien, who gains immunity to attrition less than 5. If deployed when battle begins, you may use 1 Force to choose an opposing character with ability 1 and force them to move at no movement cost. If they do not move, place them immediately in the Lost Pile. Immune to attrition less than 5.

'''Lore:''' A symbol of the noble Jedi and their mysterious power.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Obi-Wan's Cape]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
